_note: Contract regex-limit v1 (camada-all-2pap): bounded cost of customer `matches` regexes at match time, and the save-time refusal of patterns re2js cannot compile. Byte-identical copies, change all of them together and update the sha256 every suite pins: camada/edge-analyst/test/regex-limit-vectors.json, camada-backend/test/regex-limit-vectors.json, camada-web/src/lib/regex-limit-vectors.json, camada-core/test/fixtures/regex-limit/regex-limit-vectors.json (the server SDKs read this one from the camada-core sibling checkout, like blk5; CAMADA_FIXTURES_DIR overrides). An input value is a string, or {prefix?, repeat, times, suffix?} meaning prefix + repeat x times + suffix. Each row is one rule in snapshot meta form; parse it into a v5 snapshot (camada-core blk5/v5-empty.bin with meta.rules = [rule]) and match the input: hit = the result names the rule. Engine classes: linear = re2js (edge-analyst, camada-core and the JS adapters through it) and Go regexp, which give the true answer; budget = Python regex timeout, Ruby Regexp timeout (3.2+), PHP PCRE match limit, Java deadline CharSequence, .NET matchTimeout, where an over-limit run answers like an over-cap value: hit for block/challenge/warn, miss for skip. over_limit: every engine runs every row and asserts hit[class]. linear_time: linear engines only; hit as given, and a fresh compile plus the first match takes under max_ms (best of 3). refused: patterns the regex-guard screen accepts but re2js refuses; edge-analyst validateCond, camada-backend regexError and camada-web regexProblem refuse each with the re2 kind, and, for refused_rule with the pattern as its one condition, every matcher answers cases[].hit[go] in camada-go (an uncompilable pattern never matches) and hit[native] everywhere else (backtracking engines compile them; edge-analyst and camada-core fall back to native RegExp for a stored pattern re2js refuses). accepted: guard- and re2js-accepted patterns no save-time check may refuse. translate: [JS pattern, jsToRe2 output] pairs that the four JS copies (edge-analyst blocklist.js, camada-core path.ts, camada-backend rules-custom.ts, camada-web lib/rules.ts) reproduce exactly with re2js 2.9.0; other languages ignore it. constants: every port asserts its own constant equals the value here.

over_limit.why: over the limit a deny rule hits although the regex would miss
over the limit a skip rule misses
a skip whose regex truly matches still misses when the limit runs out first
a deny rule hits either way
path regexes run case-insensitively over three path forms; the limit holds there too
